crossRefs.note: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.
The whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron in the wilderness;
Moses said, “Now Yahweh will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because…

parallels.note: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come…

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses said to Aaron, “Tell all the congregation of the children of Israel, ‘Come close to Yahweh, for he has heard your murmurings.’ ”
translations.bsb: Then Moses said to Aaron, “Tell the whole congregation of Israel, ‘Come before the LORD, for He has heard your grumbling.’”
translations.kjv: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.
translations.asv: And Moses said unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before Jehovah; for he hath heard your murmurings.
